# Oleh Fedkiv

> Full-stack developer creating online stores, business and corporate websites, landing pages, promo websites, information portals, custom websites, and online services.

Canonical site: https://www.fedkiv.tech
Primary language: English
Additional language: Ukrainian
Location: Lviv, Ukraine
Contact: fedkiv20172@gmail.com

## Services

- Online Store: product catalogues, checkout, payments, order management, and CRM or delivery integrations.
- Business Website: compact websites presenting a business, its services, and contact information.
- Corporate Website: structured multi-page websites for companies, teams, expertise, and vacancies.
- Landing Page: conversion-focused one-page websites for a single offer or advertising campaign.
- Promo Website: expressive websites for product launches, events, campaigns, and special offers.
- Information Portal: content-rich websites with categories, search, publishing, and content management.
- Custom Website: tailored website solutions designed around specific business goals and audiences.
- Online Service: websites with booking, payments, user accounts, dashboards, or custom online workflows.
